  Turning Real Finance Work Into a Defined Task  
  Objective Grading Criteria

  Time per task: ~10 hours per task  
  Engagement: Project-based - paid per approved task

  CPA, CA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent is a plus, but not required.  
  Strong written English.  
  AI or LLM evaluation experience is a plus, but not required.

About the role:  We're looking for a Financial Analyst to join our FP&A team. This is a hands-on, driver-based modelling role suited to someone who wants exposure to SaaS/recurring-revenue metrics (ARR, NRR, GRR) and cross-functional finance work. What You'll Do

 Prepare board pack components, including variance tables and KPI charts

 Reconcile actuals to forecast each month-end 
 Act as finance partner to a department head, including attending the monthly BVA (budget-vs-actual) analysis meeting

 Comfort building and maintaining driver-based financial models
